- conv3: 32->64, 3x3, pad 1, ReLU, MaxPool 2x2 -> 64x4x4

- fc: 64->10 logits

Key insight: A backdoor (BadNets) typically involves a small trigger patch that activates strongly. In the weights, this might manifest as:
- A conv1 filter that is highly selective to the trigger pattern (e.g., white square, checkerboard, color noise)

After normalization: (pixel/255 - mean)/std.

So a white square patch would appear as strong positive values (~+2) in all channels in a small region. A conv1 filter that detects white would have positive weights in all channels (RGB) in that region. But conv1 is 3x3, so a 3x3 white square would match a filter with all-positive weights.
